rationale: The supplied vulnerable fragment shows GetWindowBoundsForClientBounds deriving a minimum header width from close_button_ dimensions, which is broadly reflected by the Logic sentence. However, the supplied fixed fragment contains only Init and does not include either bounds-calculation function, so it is not possible to determine whether the described caption/close-button layout behavior differs between the two implementations.
